caption: 01 · STABILIZE — Who and what need an answer today?. Inventory safety, payroll, benefits, contractors, customers, deposits, deadlines, facilities, systems, insurers, lenders, and emergency contacts. Identify the authorized interim decision-maker from actual records.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping who and what need an answer today? within The Last Collection Is an Operational Event.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 02 · FREEZE — Which changes should stop?. Preserve files, samples, accounts, logs, agreements, permissions, money movements, and public drafts; suspend deletion and irreversible publication while legal holds, privacy, and access are reviewed.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping which changes should stop? within The Last Collection Is an Operational Event.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 03 · DECIDE — Can unfinished work continue?. Assess creative authority, contributor consent, labor, contract, quality, finance, rights, customer, cultural, and reputational consequences for ship, pause, complete, transfer, or cancel.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping can unfinished work continue? within The Last Collection Is an Operational Event.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 04 · ACCOUNT — How will the institution explain the outcome?. Publish only verified decisions, preserve dissent and credits, notify affected parties before spectacle, record refunds or remedies, and archive the rationale and authority.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping how will the institution explain the outcome? within The Last Collection Is an Operational Event.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
